# InvivoGen

> > InvivoGen provides specialized reagents, cell lines, and tools for innate immunity research, cell biology, and high-throughput screening applications.

InvivoGen offers a comprehensive catalog of research products including reporter gene systems, cell culture reagents, antimicrobial agents, and engineered cell lines for studying pattern recognition receptors (PRRs), toll-like receptors (TLRs), and innate immune signaling pathways. Their products are designed for researchers in immunology, cell biology, molecular biology, and vaccine development.

## Key Topics

- Reporter Gene Systems (SEAP, Lucia, ACP5)
- Cell Lines (HEK293, A549, HCT116, HepG2)
- Innate Immunity & PRRs
- Toll-like Receptors (TLRs)
- NF-κB & IRF Signaling
- Cell Culture Reagents
- Antimicrobial Agents
- Mycoplasma Detection
- Transfection & Transduction
- Selection Antibiotics
- High-throughput Screening
- Endotoxin Detection
- Cell Death Detection
- Tet-on Inducible Expression
- RLRs & CLRs

## Reporter Gene Systems & Assays

- [Reporter Gene Based Assays | SEAP, Lucia, ACP5](https://www.invivogen.com/reporter-detection): Reporter gene systems: SEAP, Lucia luciferase, ACP5 with detection reagents
- [SEAP Reporter Gene Systems for Cell-Based Assays](https://www.invivogen.com/seap-reporter-gene-systems): SEAP reporter system for non-destructive gene expression monitoring
- [Lucia : an intense secreted luciferase](https://www.invivogen.com/lucia): Lucia luciferase reporter with 1000-fold higher signal than Firefly/Renilla
- [ACP5 Reporter Gene System](https://www.invivogen.com/acp5-reporter-gene-systems): ACP5 (TRAP) secreted reporter gene system with QUANTI-Star detection
- [Tet-on System](https://www.invivogen.com/tet-on-inducible-protein-expression): Tet-on inducible expression system with TiGer, RepTor, pTiGer vectors

## Reporter Cell Lines

- [Collection of Reporter Cell Lines from InvivoGen](https://www.invivogen.com/cell-lines): Reporter cell line catalog for PRR screening and gene function assays
- [HEK293 PRR or Cytokine Receptor | expression and reporter cells](https://www.invivogen.com/hek-293-cell-lines): HEK293 cells expressing TLRs and cytokine receptors with reporter genes
- [A549 lung carcinoma | Human NF-κB & IRF Reporter Cells](https://www.invivogen.com/a549-cell-lines): A549-Dual reporter cells with SEAP and Lucia for respiratory research
- [HCT116 colorectal carcinoma cells](https://www.invivogen.com/hct116-colorectal-carcinoma-cells): HCT116 reporter cells expressing NF-κB and IRF dual reporter systems
- [HepG2 hepatoma reporter cells](https://www.invivogen.com/hepg2-cell-lines): HepG2 reporter cells for NF-κB, IRF, and AhR signaling pathway assessment

## Cell Culture Reagents & Quality Control

- [Cell Culture Reagents | Antibiotics and Detection Kits](https://www.invivogen.com/cell-culture): Cell culture reagents: LyoVec, NATE, MycoStrip, Primocin, and detection kits
- [Antimicrobial Agents for Contaminated Cell Cultures](https://www.invivogen.com/cell-culture-contamination): Antimicrobial products: Normocin, Primocin, Fungin, Plasmocin for contamination
- [Mycoplasma detection Kits | MycoStrip & PlasmoTest](https://www.invivogen.com/mycoplasma-detection): Mycoplasma detection kits: MycoStrip and PlasmoTest for cell culture testing
- [Selection Antibiotics for Developing Stable Cell Lines](https://www.invivogen.com/selective-antibiotics): Selection antibiotics: blasticidin, puromycin, zeocin, G418 for stable cell lines
- [Cell transfection and viral transduction | Reagents](https://www.invivogen.com/cell-transfection-transduction): Transfection reagents LyoVec and NATE for nucleic acid delivery and transduction

## Cell Analysis & Detection Assays

- [Cell Death Detection](https://www.invivogen.com/cell-death-detection): Cell death detection via LDH-Blue assay, apoptosis, and cytotoxicity
- [Endotoxin Detection | Cell-based Assay](https://www.invivogen.com/endotoxin-detection-kit): LPS/endotoxin detection assays for Gram-negative bacteria monitoring

## Products & Catalog

- [InvivoGen: Reagents and Tools for Cell Biology Research](https://www.invivogen.com): InvivoGen homepage showcasing PRR ligands, TLRs, and innate immunity research tools
- [Cell Culture, Immunology & Molecular Biology Tools](https://www.invivogen.com/biological-tools): Main product catalog featuring selection antibiotics, reporter cell lines, and reagents
- [Latest Research Products](https://www.invivogen.com/new-products): New product releases including recombinant cytokines IL-25, IL-4, IL-6, IL-9
